idea-plugin.name: Merge To Target Branch
idea-plugin.description:
A Git branch merging plugin that simplifies your Git workflow by providing one-click branch merging capabilities.
Key Features: - One-click merge operation from current branch to target branch - Automatic branch switching before and after merge - Optional push to remote repository after successful merge - Smart conflict detection and notification - Convenient branch selection dialog - Automatically remember the last selected target branch for convenient repeated operations - Support setting default branch (click the star icon in the branch list) for quick selection - Supports both local and remote branch operations
This plugin helps developers save time by automating the common Git merge workflow steps.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.0.8

  • New Feature: Automatically remember the last selected target branch for convenient repeated operations
  • New Feature: Support setting default branch (click the star icon in the branch list) for quick selection of frequently used branches

action.description: Merge current branch to target branch and optionally push to remote without switching branches
